reported_snapshot.long_term_debt_note: Up from $65.6B at 2025-12-31 -- debt roughly 2.6x in nine months. Short-term borrowings $0.38B; commercial paper $0.
reported_snapshot.fcf_q_note: Q3 FCF ~ -$33.5B is FinSee's calculation (low-medium confidence); TTM figure is company-reported.
reported_snapshot.capex_guidance: 2026 cash capex ~ $220B (reiterated 2026-10-29); Jassy: 2027 capex 'meaningfully more' than 2026.
reported_snapshot.aws_rpo_note: Weighted-average remaining life 6.1 years (10-Q); more than doubled y/y.
reported_snapshot.anthropic_note: Convertible notes fair value $146.2B + nonvoting preferred $92.5B carrying value (10-Q); cost ~$18B. Unrealized gain in AOCI $140.3B.

off_balance_items.description: Leases signed but not yet commenced (mostly datacenters/logistics): $2.6B in Q4-26, $12.4B 2027, ... $114.8B thereafter.
Unconditional purchase obligations for long-term agreements to acquire property and equipment (servers, chips, datacenter equipment); $63.9B due in 2027 alone. Not on balance sheet.
Other unconditional purchase obligations: energy procurement (take-or-pay style), digital media content, software licenses.
Other commitments: asset retirement obligations, content liabilities, rent/tenant improvements on build-to-suit leases under construction. Excludes ~$7.3B of tax contingencies.

Anthropic investment: $8.0B convertible notes (2023-2025) + $5.0B Series G (Q2 2026) + $5.0B Series H (Q2 2026) = ~$18B cost; now carried at ~$238.7B ($146.2B notes FV + $92.5B preferred). Anthropic IPO priced $83/share on 2026-11-18 (~$1.5T valuation).

Committed financing facility to Anthropic, up to $15.0B remaining (originally $20B), unlocked as AWS delivers compute milestones; Anthropic draws at its discretion via convertible notes or stock; expires 30 months after liquidity event. Classic supplier-funds-customer structure.
OpenAI investment: $50.0B of Series C Preferred ($15.0B Q1 + $13.7B Q2 + $21.3B Q3 2026), fully funded; recorded as non-equity-method private investment (Level 3).
OpenAI AWS commitment: original $38B (Nov 2025) expanded by $100B over 8 years in Q1 2026 (~$138B total), incl. ~2GW of Trainium capacity -- concurrent with Amazon's $50B investment in OpenAI.
Anthropic committed >$100B to AWS over 10 years (Apr 2026, up to 5GW); Anthropic S-1 reportedly shows $110B committed to AWS through 2036 -- concurrent with Amazon's $5B + up to $20B investment.
off_balance_items.source_title: TIKR (citing CNBC reading of Anthropic S-1); Anthropic announcement

off_balance_items.description: AWS backlog $578B (6.1-yr avg life). OpenAI (~$138B) + Anthropic (~$110B) commitments = ~$248B, i.e. roughly 43% of backlog if fully included (our arithmetic; Amazon does not disclose the split). Both labs received Amazon equity funding. Anthropic is also building its own datacenters ('Anthropic Direct' via Fluidstack), capping future AWS share.
Standby letters of credit assigned to specific beneficiaries.

total_note: Sum of hard, quantified non-debt items from the 10-Q commitments table: leases not yet commenced $164.9B + P&E purchase obligations $159.6B + other unconditional purchase obligations $94.8B + other commitments $19.0B = $438.3B, plus the $15.0B contingent Anthropic financing facility = ~$453.3B. Excluded: on-balance-sheet rows of the same table (debt principal+interest $294.3B, operating leases $121.5B, finance leases $18.0B, financing obligations $11.6B; total table $883.6B), already-funded investments (OpenAI $50B, Anthropic $18B), customer commitments to AWS (revenue, not obligations), standby LCs ($21.6B), tax contingencies ($7.3B). Equals ~2.7x TTM operating cash flow ($168.3B), on top of negative TTM FCF.

credit_signals.detail: AA (S&P Global Ratings) cited at March 2026 bond sale.
A1 senior unsecured affirmed, outlook stable, despite $200B 2026 capex plan (reports conflict: one outlet says Baa1/Aa -- treat agency letter with medium confidence).
~$37B US (11 tranches, ~$126B orders) + EUR14.5B (~$16.8B) debut euro deal; ~$54B total; new-issue concession ~10-12bp.
'Surprise' $25B, 8 tranches (3-40yr); 18-21bp new-issue concession on long bonds; book only 2.5x (vs 3.2x in March); hyperscaler spreads widened 6-15bp that day. 2026 borrowing ~ $92B.
First sterling bonds (4 tranches, 3-19yr), guidance +70 to +110bp over gilts; also record CHF and CAD deals earlier in 2026; 2026 programme >$92B equivalent.
Oct 2026: new $5.0B 364-day revolver and new $15.0B unsecured revolving credit facility replaced prior agreements.
AI spending 'threatens credit quality' of hyperscalers incl. Amazon; Moody's treats >$820B of unstarted leases across group as debt-equivalent; no imminent downgrade.

news_context.headline_summary: Q3 2026: sales $201.9B, AWS +39% to $46.0B, backlog $578B; capex $77.3B (~$20B above expectations); TTM FCF -$42.4B; EPS $1.89 missed; stock fell >7% after hours; 2027 capex to be 'meaningfully more'.
news_context.why_it_matters: Amazon is now spending more than it earns in cash and plans to spend even more next year -- the gap is being filled with debt.

news_context.headline_summary: 10-Q: long-term debt $173.1B vs $65.6B at year-start; total commitments $883.6B incl. $164.9B unstarted leases; completed $50B OpenAI investment with final $21.3B in Q3.
news_context.why_it_matters: Shows both the on-balance debt surge and the larger off-balance commitments a ratio-based scorer would miss.

news_context.headline_summary: Anthropic S-1 shows $110B committed to AWS through 2036 and $114.5B to Google; Anthropic is also renting its own datacenters ('Anthropic Direct' via Fluidstack).
news_context.why_it_matters: Amazon's biggest AI customer is both funded by Amazon and starting to compete with AWS, limiting future AWS growth from it.

news_context.headline_summary: Anthropic priced a record $81.3B IPO at $83/share, ~ $1.5T valuation.
news_context.why_it_matters: Validates Amazon's ~$238.7B paper stake (and gives a liquid asset it could monetize), but also means Amazon's equity cushion is partly tied to AI-lab valuations.

news_context.headline_summary: Amazon sold its first sterling bonds, pushing 2026 borrowing past $92B across USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, GBP.
news_context.why_it_matters: Tapping every currency market signals how much external financing the capex plan needs.

news_context.headline_summary: $25B 'surprise' bond required 18-21bp extra yield; demand fell to 2.5x cover.
news_context.why_it_matters: Early sign investors are demanding more to fund AI debt -- the credit-tightening channel in the thesis.

news_context.headline_summary: Big Tech raised $253.4B of new long-term debt in nine months (~45% of capex); local opposition grows (Sunbury, Ohio voters barred >25MW datacenters, hitting a $2B AWS campus).
news_context.why_it_matters: Debt-funded capex plus power/permit pushback raises the risk of stranded or delayed capacity.

hidden_leverage_assessment.rationale: Amazon's reported debt has jumped from $66B to $173B this year and its trailing free cash flow is negative $42B, so even the visible books show strain. Off the balance sheet it has another ~$453B of commitments -- unstarted leases, equipment and energy purchase obligations, and a $15B credit line for Anthropic -- about 2.7x a year of operating cash flow. It has also invested $68B into OpenAI and Anthropic, which together promised ~$248B of AWS spending, a textbook vendor-financing loop. Amazon is still highly rated (AA/A1), has $114B of cash and a now-public Anthropic stake worth far more than it paid, so it is not in danger -- but it is relying on bond markets and on two cash-burning AI labs to make the math work.
hidden_leverage_assessment.biggest_hidden_risk: If OpenAI or Anthropic slow their spending, a big chunk of the $578B AWS backlog could shrink while Amazon is still locked into ~$325B of equipment purchases and unstarted leases funded with new debt.
hidden_leverage_assessment.what_would_change_my_mind: A return to positive free cash flow in 2027 with debt flat, or disclosure that OpenAI+Anthropic are a small share of AWS backlog, would lower this to Moderate; a drop in the Anthropic share price or failed/expensive bond deals would push it to High.
